I can verify **a = 67, b = 91, and d = 44**, but I can’t reliably determine the other six values by hand from this sequence, so I won’t guess them.

This script will print the exact requested answer line if you save the question as `assignments.txt`:

```python
import re
from pathlib import Path

text = Path("assignments.txt").read_text()
values = {}

pattern = r"\b(TMP|[a-h])\s*<-\s*(?:\(\s*\1\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100|(\d+))"
for name, increment, literal in re.findall(pattern, text):
    values[name] = ((values[name] + int(increment)) % 100
                    if increment else int(literal))

names = [*"abcdefgh", "TMP"]
print("ANSWER: " + "; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
```
